title: ii-V-I in C major
raisedBecause: Seventh chords split between the hands, a left-hand root that leaps a fifth on every change, and the G7 voiced without its fifth; the notes alone measure Beginner.
trains: The jazz cadence ii7-V7-Imaj7, split between the hands: the left hand plays the roots D, G, C, the right hand F A C, then F G B (F stays), then E G B (G and B stay). The fifth of G7 is left out.
